premises.text: Unlike niche telco, PBX, or developer API vendors, 2600 Hertz is a one-stop switch where all telecommunication services come from one system
premises.evidence_span: there hasn't been a single platform where you can actually get all of your telecommunication services from the same system until today

premises.text: Mobile is integrated directly into the switch on the cellular voice channel (not OTT data), so business routing/logic and features run on real phone calls
premises.evidence_span: utilizing the Sprint network, we have been able to integrate mobile with our switch directly

premises.text: Because calls run through the switch, customers can set up private telecom networks for security-sensitive organizations
premises.evidence_span: you can actually set up private telecom networks

premises.text: Activation and device control are exposed via APIs so customers can attach their own software or non-phone devices
premises.evidence_span: all of this technology, even the activation of the cell phone, is being done via APIs that are exposed to you

value.text: Businesses get real business-phone capabilities on mobile with reliable voice quality and unified telecom services
value.evidence_span: These switches help their businesses communicate better

causal_links.evidence_span: 2600 Hertz is a one-stop shop where all of these APIs and all of this functionality come in one box
This is an actual tie-in to the cellular network where your mobile call is going over actual phone channel
you can attach your own software and your own systems to activate the cellular devices

notes: BYOD activation, presence, non-GPS location, seamless transfer, recording, real-time transcription, cheaper IP international, and native voice-channel quality folded inside the mobile-switch integration premise as a feature cascade (§4.1.7 canonical). Private networks kept with that switch path. API/developer surface split as independently revisable module. Anti-template: one-stop platform, mobile integration, and APIs separately revisable.
